art_note: The image features a flat-looking digital all-over print on a standard mockup model against a plain white background, lacking high-end luxury editorial styling.
desc_en: A visual exploration of movement and form. This dress features a graphic contour wave design set against a pure white canvas. Each piece is crafted to order. We offer worldwide shipping to accommodate your global lifestyle. A defined silhouette that embraces the figure with understated elegance. A minimalist concept designed for the contemporary woman who seeks effortless distinction.
desc_es: Una exploracion visual del movimiento y la forma. Este vestido presenta un diseño grafico de ondas contorneadas sobre un lienzo blanco puro. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido en nuestras instalaciones. Ofrecemos envios a todo el mundo para satisfacer sus necesidades globales. Silueta definida que acompaña la figura con elegancia sobria. Un concepto minimalista pensado para la mujer contemporanea que busca distincion sin esfuerzo.
